findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: The stand was displaying large slabs of focaccia which is pre-cut and served with tongs. The PIC was informed that the focaccia needs to be protected from sneeze, splash, and debris during display. The PIC created a temporary solution in the form of a box and plastic lid. A follow-up will be conducted on June 3, 2026 to ensure the focaccia is properly protected.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the current method of cold holding to be insufficient (cheese surface temperature 68F). CORRECTED: Display cheese will not be sold to the consumer. Discussed with PIC sacrificing the display and keeping cheese in a cooler. Inspectors will spot check cold holding at future markets.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed there was not soap at the front hand washing sink. During the inspection the PIC brought a bottle of soap to the hand washing sink. Ensure that there is always soap available at every hand washing sink.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed the sanitizer bucket was testing at 0 ppm (quat). During the inspection the sanitizer bucket was re-made testing at 200 ppm (quat). Ensure that sanitizing solutions are always testing at the correct concentration (200-400 ppm for quat).
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
THIS IS A FIRST REPAT VIOLATION FROM THE PRE-OPENING:

Observed the cove base to the left of the triple sink is peeling away from the wall. Ensure that the cove base is sealed to the wall by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
